files.adaptation: Accepts a standalone human JSON file or dataset directory through the shared behavior reader. Draws recorded rectangles and colors with the translated game description for draw order. Uses the source canvas, resize, grayscale, frame-stacking and action-index conventions. Output metadata retains the nullable original play outcome. Uses package-qualified bundled inference imports; exposes a direct Python module entrypoint. Canonical frame rendering does not initialize the training engine or Pygame. Reads recorded grid dimensions and sprites directly; source-level simulation is not an extraction input.
